decision: BOOK remains one first-class peer system with one logical canonical Book parent writer. The Book product is composed of bounded Book-owned domain components around that parent aggregate and integrates with shared peer capabilities only through explicit ports. No component may create a second canonical writer, a second shared orchestrator, a Book-owned generic document engine, a Book-owned general research engine, or an active PROSE execution route.
constitutional_invariants: Exactly one logical canonical Book parent writer owns current canonical Book/manuscript state.
All canonical mutation is typed, exact-current, replay-safe, versioned and receipt-backed; generic PATCH or silent in-place overwrite is forbidden.
Specialist analysis, model output, research, document conversion, media rendering and external actions return evidence, artifacts or proposals and never self-canonize.
Author final semantic and creative authority is preserved wherever an author decision is required.
Story Bible/canon/world-state semantics remain Book-owned even when retrieval, persistence or rendering is delegated.
The 227-step Book lifecycle remains internal planning/gate intelligence and is projected to a small user-facing stage model rather than exposed as 227 user steps.
Technical export does not imply publication authorization.
Historical exact-SHA qualification never transfers to changed current subjects.
PROSE remains terminally retired as a peer/execution lane; preserved prose capability is integrated inside Book-owned authoring intelligence rather than resurrected as a system.

canonical_components.name: CANONICAL_PARENT_STATE_AND_VERSIONING
canonical_components.rule: This is the sole logical canonical writer.

canonical_components.name: AUTHORING_LIFECYCLE_GATES_AND_NEXT_STEP
canonical_components.rule: Lifecycle transitions commit only through BOOK-COMP-02; user-facing stages are a projection, not a second lifecycle truth.

canonical_components.name: AUTHOR_DECISION_CONTENT_ADMISSION_AND_RIGHTS_GUARDS
canonical_components.rule: Decisions and evidence are admitted through typed parent effects; missing human, rights or external authority fails closed.

canonical_components.name: BOOK_INTELLIGENCE_REVISION_AND_EVALUATION
canonical_components.rule: Recovered completed prose capability is expressed here as Book-owned capability; findings/candidates require admission and never write canonical state directly.

canonical_components.name: BOOK_CONTEXT_AND_RESEARCH_ADMISSION
canonical_components.rule: General search/retrieval/provenance stays RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE; Book owns only Book-specific selection, interpretation and admission.

canonical_components.name: EXISTING_BOOK_RECOVERY_AND_SEMANTIC_INGESTION
canonical_components.rule: Generic OCR/PDF/DOCX parsing and conversion are delegated to DOCUMENTS; recovered semantics become canonical only through BOOK-COMP-06 and BOOK-COMP-02.

canonical_components.name: BOOK_LONG_JOB_PROFILE_AND_WORKFLOW_COORDINATION
canonical_components.rule: CORE owns the shared scheduler/orchestrator, durable execution machinery, resource admission and A-01; Book supplies Book semantics and bounded jobs only.

canonical_components.name: EXPORT_FREEZE_AND_PUBLICATION_PACKAGE
canonical_components.rule: DOCUMENTS owns generic DOCX/PDF/EPUB/accessibility/conversion mechanics; MEDIA owns audiobook/media rendering; CONNECTED_ACTIONS owns external publication/transmission side effects.

canonical_components.name: BOOK_RECOVERY_BACKUP_RESTORE_OFFLINE_PROFILE
canonical_components.rule: CORE owns physical persistence, storage, backup/restore mechanics and shared durability. Book defines what constitutes a semantically complete and valid Book recovery.

canonical_components.name: BOOK_QUALIFICATION_REGRESSION_AND_HUMAN_EVIDENCE_PROFILE
canonical_components.rule: This replaces a permanent standalone world-class comparison program; qualification evidence cannot self-promote canonical state or production standing.

canonical_flow: BOOK-COMP-01 establishes immutable identity and versioned governing intent.
BOOK-COMP-03 and BOOK-COMP-04 maintain Book-owned canon/knowledge/plan/manuscript candidates as immutable versioned objects.
BOOK-COMP-05 determines legal lifecycle state, readiness, invalidation and next dependency-valid work.
BOOK-COMP-07, BOOK-COMP-08 and BOOK-COMP-09 produce bounded findings, context, recovery candidates or revision candidates.
BOOK-COMP-06 preserves author decisions, rights/custody state and admission decisions and prepares typed canonical effects.
BOOK-COMP-02 alone validates exact-current preconditions and commits a new immutable canonical parent version.
BOOK-COMP-10 coordinates durable Book work through CORE without creating another orchestrator.
BOOK-COMP-11 freezes one exact canonical version and requests artifact/media/external services without transferring publication authority.
BOOK-COMP-12 proves Book semantic recoverability over CORE durability mechanics.
BOOK-COMP-13 continuously checks representative invariants and journeys without becoming a second product runtime.

CONNECTED_ACTIONS: credentialed external actions with explicit user authority
LEARNING: Book-derived learning handoff where explicitly requested
SPREADSHEET_DATA: structured analysis, tables and quantitative work requested by Book workflows
PROGRAMMING: software/build/programming services requested by Book workflows; no Book semantic authority

forbidden_components_or_routes: automatic canonical promotion from model/evaluator/provider output
permanent BOOK-ENG-010 mega-comparison program on the release critical path

user_surface_projection.rule: The surface is a projection of canonical Book state and workflow evidence. It does not own canonical state or expose the full internal 227-step lifecycle by default.

qualification_effect: NONE_BY_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION. This record freezes component/ownership boundaries only. It does not establish current implementation, native/provider fidelity, human quality, publication authority, production readiness or whole-app qualification.
